facts.fact: The Ministry of Lands is reviewing LIMS workflows and developing digital procedures to move the remaining manual land transactions onto the platform.
Malawi launched LIMS in February 2024, a web-based system linking Lands, Surveys and Physical Planning where registered users can view land parcels and assets.
Registered LIMS users can submit documents, receive notifications and make payments, including ground rent and application fees.
